name: Gagosian Gallery
description: Contemporary and modern art gallery with multiple locations

summary.text: Gagosian Gallery is a modern and contemporary art gallery owned and directed by Larry Gagosian. The gallery exhibits some of the most well-known artists of the 20th and 21st centuries.
summary.title: Gagosian Gallery

17194368: Race Riot is a 1964 acrylic and silkscreen painting by the American artist Andy Warhol that he executed in 1964. It fetched $62,885,000 at Christie's in New York on 13 May 2014.
22329584: Kappo Masa is a Japanese restaurant located within the Gagosian Gallery on Madison Avenue on the Upper East Side of Manhattan in New York City.
